mapper.select: SELECT * FROM rag_document WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rag_document WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_document ( knowledge_base_id, title, file_name, file_type, file_size, file_path, chunk_count, status, error_message, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{title}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{filePath}, #{chunkCount}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_document SET knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId}, title = #{title}, file_name = #{fileName}, file_type = #{fileType}, file_size = #{fileSize}, file_path = #{filePath}, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, status = #{status}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, created_by = #{createdBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE rag_document SET chunk_count = chunk_count + #{count}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
